name: branding-scribbled-girly-script-logo-with-face-mascot-on-soda-cans
title: Hand-scribbled 'Girly' signature with speech-bubble face, a doll mascot and pink and lime soda cans
whatItIs: A white slide with a loose single-line script 'Girly' whose tail loops around an oval with a tiny face, then two photos: die-cut stickers of the mascot and script on a pink car window, and a fridge of pink and lime cans with a doll-like character in a pink jumpsuit.
whatItMeans: Cheeky and youthful; scribbled lettering and a big-eyed doll feel like a zine drink.
techniques: Write the logo as a fast single-line scribble.
Tuck a face into the flourish.
Alternate pink and lime pack colours.

vocabulary.definition: A face hidden in a logo's tail.
Artwork printed around a beverage can.
A sticker cut to the shape of its art.
